//: Type-checks src AND tests. The build config sets rootDir ./src while excluding (or simply not including) tests/**/*, so a plain `tsc --noEmit` never looked at a single test file; this config is what puts them in the program. `pnpm build` still uses tsconfig.json, so nothing here can change what the build emits.
//exclude: Restated on purpose. `exclude` is inherited from the extended config and filters `include`, so a package that later excludes "tests" there would silently drop every test file out of this program and each type guarantee in them would pass vacuously.
